title: What If You Used 100 Percent of Your Brain?

scenes.text: What if you used one hundred percent of your brain? Here's the twist: you already do.
The ten percent idea traces back to the early nineteen hundreds, and there is no evidence behind it.
Brain scans show you use nearly every region during routine tasks like talking, walking or listening to music.
Even asleep, regions of your brain run your breathing, your heart rate and your balance. Over a day, you likely activate all of it.
Your brain is only about three percent of your body weight, yet it burns about twenty percent of your energy.
There is no hidden ninety percent waiting to unlock. You're already running nearly all of it, and paying a fifth of your energy for it.

description:
What if you used 100 percent of your brain?
You already do. Brain scans show nearly every region switching on over a normal day, and the whole organ burns about a fifth of your energy.
